company.name: PopSQL
company.shortDescription: PopSQL is a modern, collaborative SQL editor for teams.
company.description:
PopSQL is used by data analysts, product managers, customer success, operations, and anyone that wants to write SQL.

It was founded in 2017 and is based in San Francisco, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A SQL editor designed for team collaboration, enabling centralized query management, real-time editing, and interactive data visualization.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL Collaborative SQL Editor

productsAndServices.description: A system to securely connect PopSQL to various databases using multiple connection methods including direct, cloud, SSH tunnels, and bridge connectors.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL Database Connections and Connectivity

productsAndServices.description: Features that allow multiple users to collaborate on SQL queries simultaneously with commenting, version control, and shared connections.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL Real-Time Collaboration Features

productsAndServices.description: Tools within PopSQL to create charts, lightweight dashboards, and interactive reports directly from SQL query results.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL Data Visualization and Dashboarding

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables users to combine multiple SQL queries, charts, and Markdown text to create data stories and reports.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL SQL Notebooks

productsAndServices.description: APIs for query management and scheduling, plus integration with Git for version control and code review.
productsAndServices.name: PopSQL API and Git Integration
